scope: README Standards And Governance and Methods And Risk References; engineering traceability, not certification

references.limitation: CI and inspection support secure development; supplier governance, release evidence and vulnerability-response ownership remain incomplete.
Shared API keys are not individual/firm authorization. Tailored control baseline, audit protection, update governance and operational assessment remain release gates.
Owned shutdown and candidate-only recovery are bounded controls, not a complete lifecycle assurance case or a production recovery drill.
Scope and provenance checks do not establish full AI governance, deployed-model evaluations, monitoring or organizational risk acceptance. Some legacy tests are unit-only.

references.version: Revised Section 508 Standards (2017, applicable updates); WCAG 2.0 A/AA incorporation
references.limitation: Keyboard, labels, reduced-motion and mobile checks are bounded evidence. Full assistive-technology, contrast, export and conformance assessment is not complete.
Fail-closed ownership and non-overwrite controls reflect hazard reduction. No formal DoD hazard log, acceptance authority or system-safety certification is claimed.
Fixed current quantities on shared prices are a price-return reconstruction, not transaction/cash-flow-adjusted historical client performance.

references.version: William F. Sharpe, The Sharpe Ratio (1994)
references.limitation: Constant annual risk-free convention and square-root-time scaling are explicit approximations; no serial-correlation adjustment or predictive guarantee.

references.version: RiskMetrics Technical Document, 4th edition (1996); historical method reference
references.limitation: EWMA uses lambda 0.94 and sqrt(h) scaling. Historical VaR and inclusive empirical tail mean are documented Lotbook conventions, not regulatory ES.

references.version: DOJ HHI overview updated 2024-01-17, referencing 2023 Merger Guidelines
references.limitation: Lotbook sums squared sector fractions of priced securities (0-1), not firm market percentages (0-10000). Manual assets are excluded; no-data zero remains a sentinel. No antitrust or suitability conclusion. Legacy route evidence remains limited.
Full-window mean/sample standard deviation, k=0.5s, h=5s default and reset on signals. Retrospective detection, not online calibration or a false-alarm probability.

references.version: William F. Sharpe, Capital Asset Prices (1964)
references.limitation: Aligned sample covariance/variance estimates and alpha are descriptive, not a validated expected-return forecast. Zero benchmark variance is unavailable.

references.version: Bandt and Pompe, Physical Review Letters 88, 174102 (2002)
references.limitation: Normalized ordinal-pattern entropy on reconstructed values. General-order tie semantics and legacy insufficient-input zeros need further hardening; not confidence.

references.version: H. E. Hurst, Long-Term Storage Capacity of Reservoirs (1951)
references.limitation: DOI/title verified with Crossref publisher metadata; full publisher text unavailable in this pass. Disjoint-block R/S slope clipped to [0,1]; finite-sample bias and predictive validity are not established.

references.version: Basel Framework MAR33, current edition effective 2023-01-01, published 2020-06-05
references.limitation: Regulatory ES is not implemented. 95/99% period-return tail means are not 97.5% stressed, liquidity-adjusted, approved capital models. National adoption and supervisory requirements require separate review.
